# cluster-topology

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/cluster-topology.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `cluster-topology` component of `libs/platform`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.cluster`: generated from its catalogue, cluster-topology.json, by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_CLUSTER_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING`, `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER`, `OPERATOR_API`, `FAPI` (components).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_CLUSTER_MODE` | Unset; one of `STANDALONE`, `CLUSTERED_ENGINE`, `CLUSTERED_CONSOLE`, `CLUSTERED_DUAL` | This node's place in a PingFederate cluster, in PingFederate's own names (any case): STANDALONE, CLUSTERED_ENGINE, CLUSTERED_CONSOLE or CLUSTERED_DUAL. Unset, the node reads PingFederate's pf.operational.mode; set, it wins, and a pf.operational.mode that names another mode is a mismatch. A clustered node in production needs Redis, PingFederate data stores, a JDBC lease backend and JDBC OAuth client storage, and a CLUSTERED_CONSOLE node runs no background jobs (docs/operator/clustering.md) | **Doesn't start**: Not one of the four names, or a mode pf.operational.mode contradicts: the topology is unknown, and under the production profile every component is REFUSED and answers 503, ready is 503, and PingFederate's own endpoints keep serving; under development it is a WARN and the node runs as standalone would | Any; refuses `FEDERATION`, `AUTO_REGISTRATION`, `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER`, `HOSTING`, `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER`, `OPERATOR_API`, `FAPI` | Yes |
| `pf.operational.mode` (system property) | Unset | PingFederate's own setting, never this repository's: run.properties' operational mode, which PingFederate's start-up makes a system property of the whole JVM (STANDALONE in the image's run.properties; the image's OPERATIONAL_MODE sets it). Read when OIDF_CLUSTER_MODE is unset, trimmed and in any case, as PingFederate reads it; blank or a value that is not one of PingFederate's four modes is an unknown topology here, where PingFederate itself would run standalone | **Doesn't start**: Unset, blank or not one of STANDALONE, CLUSTERED_ENGINE, CLUSTERED_CONSOLE and CLUSTERED_DUAL with OIDF_CLUSTER_MODE unset: as OIDF_CLUSTER_MODE's unknown topology. Set OIDF_CLUSTER_MODE to say what the node is | Any | Yes |
